name: com.mcp-game-deck
description: Drive Claude Code against the Unity Editor through 269 MCP tools across 37 domains. v2.0 ships a dedicated external desktop app (Tauri) that survives assembly reloads, a model picker with per-turn switching, persistent plans and rules, an in-editor knowledge reader, and 12 Unity-specialist subagents. The Unity package is the thin connector; the chat lives in the external app launched via the toolbar pin.
